author: The Kobeissi Letter
text: The cost of servicing US debt is the highest in decades: On Thursday, the US government sold $25 billion of 30Y Treasury bonds at a 5.216% yield, the highest auction yield since 2001. This follows a $42 billion auction of 10Y Treasury notes on Wednesday.
